title: Test suite can invoke the developer's real assistant subscription: inherited CLAUDECODE outranks HUNCH_SYNTH_PROVIDER in auto-review tests
observation: test/autoreview-cli.test.ts spreads the whole parent process.env into the spawned CLI and only overrides PATH/HUNCH_SYNTH_PROVIDER=codex-cli with a stub `codex`. resolveSynthesisProvider consults currentInitiator(env) BEFORE HUNCH_SYNTH_PROVIDER, and detectInitiator maps an inherited CLAUDECODE=1 to claude-cli, so running `npm test` from inside a Claude Code session runs the REAL `claude` binary on the developer's subscription with fixture drafts ('Judging N draft(s) via claude-cli (subscription)'). Under Codex it would flip the other way. Static trace, not reproduced under a debugger. Open product question: should an explicit HUNCH_SYNTH_PROVIDER outrank the detected initiator? Tracked as GitHub issue #378.
